metadata.title: Source-linked mathematical bibliography and reading routes
metadata.source_scope: 1,051 main treatments plus 14 retained 2023 annual syntheses; 71 atlas families; all four annual reference lists; Hamiltonian context references.
metadata.deduplication: Conservative canonical document URL: lowercase scheme/host and remove only fragment. Preserve scheme, path case, query and all exact original URLs. No mirror, redirect, DOI/arXiv-version or HTTP/HTTPS equivalence is guessed.
metadata.counting: source_uid_count counts unique treatments that explicitly retain the URL in their reference fields, including separately marked original historical refs. Family, annual-list and Hamiltonian-context citations are counted separately; family membership does not imply direct source citation.
metadata.availability: No network lookup or third-party PDF download is performed by this builder. References are provenance links, not blanket endorsement or proof dependencies.

reading_routes.title: Recover a target, then decide which observation is worth buying
reading_routes.question: What is the smallest observation that still determines the target or preserves the action?
reading_routes.reading: Begin with equivalence classes and a transition rule that respects those classes. For linear data Hx and target Gx, work through ker H⊆ker G and G=LH, then calculate the recovery norm. Only after present target recovery is settled should you ask whether the observed state closes dynamically; HA=TH is an additional condition. Read hidden-target risk next: an unobserved coordinate can leave irreducible conditional variation even when observed noise tends to zero. Shared uncertainty then changes a decision difference because common terms cancel. Finish with the finite cheapest-experiment recursion, where the terminal condition is constancy of the target, rather than identification of every state.
reading_routes.checkpoint: Produce both a factorization certificate and a counterexample invisible vector for a failing target. In L01 compare the cheapest probes for the scalar target and a larger target. In L08 retain the same common uncertain variable in both actions.
reading_routes.boundary: These finite exact examples do not establish nonlinear global fibre constancy, future predictive performance or an optimal noisy sensor policy.

reading_routes.title: From boundary matrices to gluing and transport
reading_routes.question: Which local data assemble to a global object, and which obstruction survives?
reading_routes.reading: Compute an actual chain complex before interpreting its homology: verify that the product of successive boundaries is zero, and keep the coefficient ring. L09 compares a graph cycle with the complex obtained by filling its face. Continue to integer torsion and cochain gluing, where a real nullspace calculation can lose an integral obstruction. A logarithmic differential then supplies a complementary local-to-global example: locally closed need not mean globally exact because loop periods remain. Connections and gauge transport add ordered matrix products. L05 displays order dependence for two shears, but a two-matrix loop is not a construction of curvature on an arbitrary manifold.
reading_routes.checkpoint: Write down the boundary or Čech maps and one obstruction class. Compare a zero local differential with a nonzero loop period, then keep the shear commutator distinct from the projection contraction in the second L05 mode.
reading_routes.boundary: A picture of overlapping patches, an adjacency graph or a sampled transport loop does not determine a sheaf, its coefficient system, its derived comparison maps or a global connection.

reading_routes.title: Spectral representation, stable evolution and inverse resolution
reading_routes.question: When does a spectral formula control a trajectory or a reconstruction error?
reading_routes.reading: Start with a self-adjoint operator and its domain, multiplicities and spectral measure. Derive the heat semigroup and its mean-zero energy decay before comparing it with a finite stencil. Check conservation, positivity and stability separately, and use normalized grid norms when discussing a continuum rate. The Lyapunov example then shows why stable eigenvalues do not rule out temporary Euclidean growth. Move to the inverse problem last: positive singular values give uniqueness, while a small singular-value tail makes the inverse unbounded. The admissible source ellipsoid and deterministic noise norm determine a cutoff bound with two distinct terms.
reading_routes.checkpoint: In L04 compare bias, noise amplification and total upper bound while changing N. In severe mode keep the logarithmic safety margin; that implemented mode fixes β=1. Use L05 only for the stated two-line principal-angle model, not as a substitute inverse solver.
reading_routes.boundary: A residual-to-error bound needs operator hypotheses, and fixed-time trace class differs from a small-time heat asymptotic. No one lab implements all the PDE, frame or control recipes in this route.

reading_routes.title: Exact populations, summaries and information loss
reading_routes.question: What can be counted exactly, and which distinctions are lost by a compressed statistic?
reading_routes.reading: Construct a finite population and its reversible address before using asymptotic approximations. L02 exhausts a six-item selection problem and exposes feasible counts, ranks and optimal values. Read random inclusion laws with a declared sampling model next; independence, fixed-size sampling and weighted sampling produce different pair probabilities. The graph-census family gives a stronger counterexample to overinterpreting summaries: two graphs can agree on a binary size–energy census while integer-height probes distinguish them. This connects exact enumeration to observation equivalence. A quotient suitable for optimization must preserve multiplicities if counts or probabilities are also requested.
reading_routes.checkpoint: Check a rank/unrank round trip and a lower-bound certificate for the finite optimum. In L03 compare the entire exact coefficient census, then evaluate it at a chosen floating q while retaining the distinction between the polynomial identity and its numerical value.
reading_routes.boundary: The six-item and seven-vertex examples do not reconstruct missing large-instance historical tables. A matching summary is an equivalence only relative to its stated probes.

reading_routes.title: Poisson geometry to exact Moyal partners and coherent dynamics
reading_routes.question: When does a nonlinear Hamiltonian admit exact classical–quantum partners, and when does equality persist under evolution?
reading_routes.reading: Fix one canonical pair, a characteristic-zero coefficient field and the flat Weyl–Moyal convention. Compute every nonzero odd transvectant gate rather than only the cubic correction. L06 makes this finite polynomial calculation inspectable. Then read the Hamiltonian note: separate the one-step kernel E(H), active partners with nonzero first bracket, the iterated invariant core D∞(H), exact Lie sectors and product closure. The note supplies all-degree proofs for its stated cubic, homogeneous-quartic, qF(p) and monomial classes, while finite fixtures independently replay named instances. The observability bridge interprets the coherent core as the invariant space invisible to correction outputs; exact invariance must be checked in the full polynomial ring.
reading_routes.checkpoint: Read the universal-observable theorem of Robert with its quantifier before comparing a restricted polynomial partner family. Reproduce a partner whose second action fails, and contrast it with an invariant exact sector. Use the pinned PerfectJet documents to locate the existing full-sextic through-degree-20 result.
reading_routes.boundary: Universal Schwartz-observable exactness is different from a restricted infinite polynomial sector. The retained full-space sextic classification has archived msolve dependencies; degrees 21 and above and independent proof-carrying replay remain separate obligations. A nonlinear canonical map need not preserve the same flat star product.

reading_routes.title: Arithmetic reduction with complete orbit certificates
reading_routes.question: How can a finite certificate establish a statement about an infinite arithmetic family?
reading_routes.reading: Begin with the scalar ring, residue system and p-adic precision. A root modulo p^n becomes a genuine p-adic root only with a compatible lifting and completeness argument. Cyclotomic reduction then provides a finite exact map whose fibres can be exhausted. L07 evaluates the unit reduction underlying the displayed phase map. Move to Pell orbits next: a unit action generates candidates, but a reduction argument and complete seed list are required for exhaustiveness. L10 navigates exact integer iterates of a proved orbit decomposition. Norm forms and elliptic height lattices extend the same pattern while adding class, unit, descent and saturation conditions.
reading_routes.checkpoint: Display one exact congruence or determinant certificate and state the theorem connecting it to the infinite result. For a Pell claim, identify all seeds and verify the descent that reaches them, rather than only computing many iterates.
reading_routes.boundary: Finite residues do not certify an exact zero by themselves. A rational-point search does not prove completeness without the corresponding descent, rank and saturation obligations.

reading_routes.title: Periods, singular differential equations and asymptotic constants
reading_routes.question: How does a specified integral become a differential equation and a controlled limiting value?
reading_routes.reading: Use the exact-integral family to establish a convergent representation, a branch and an interchange argument. Mellin moments provide a transparent example with a rational tail bound. For a parameter-dependent period, supply its operator and cycle data before calling it Picard–Fuchs. The Frobenius divided difference demonstrates how a logarithm emerges from coalescing exponents while the normalized Wronskian stays nonzero. Continue around a singular point to distinguish identity monodromy from a matrix whose eigenvalues are merely all one. Finish with the factorial Borel model, cubic fold and elliptic logarithmic constant: each states a small parameter and a quantified finite remainder or exact scaling identity.
reading_routes.checkpoint: Carry branch, cycle, normalization and operator metadata through one calculation. Distinguish a removable basis pole from singular boundary data, then compare a convergent evaluation with a divergent but valid finite asymptotic expansion.
reading_routes.boundary: A period name does not recover a missing differential operator. A local germ does not determine global Stokes constants, and naming a period does not prove algebraic independence.

reading_routes.title: From random laws to reliable robust decisions
reading_routes.question: Which uncertainty model supports a useful action guarantee?
reading_routes.reading: Specify the joint law or deterministic uncertainty set before computing a variance or worst-case range. Stochastic dynamics requires its own time discretization and Itô correction; a marginal law does not determine dependence. Conditional risk identifies uncertainty left by the observation itself, whereas independent repeated measurements may only reduce sensor noise. Statistical validation then asks whether a procedure calibrated on one sample predicts another. In the deterministic branch, duality and robust difference bounds provide certificates for an action across a declared set. Correlated errors can cancel in a comparison even when their separate marginal intervals are wide.
reading_routes.checkpoint: Separate irreducible target uncertainty, observation noise, model uncertainty and finite-sample calibration. In L08 check the exact action difference under a shared variable, and in L01 test whether a new probe removes a target-relevant null direction.
reading_routes.boundary: A deterministic interval is not a confidence interval without a probabilistic coverage argument. Development-set optimality is neither causal evidence nor an out-of-sample guarantee.
